{{RPG}}
'''Tobin's Hollow''' is a village in [[Toman Head]], close to the border of [[Almoth Plain]] and the village of [[Aturo's Orchard]].<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
==History and geography==
Tobin's Hollow is occupied by the Seanchan when they land on Toman Head, though several villagers manage to escape the settlement. Among them is [[Bryna Lisbet]], the [[Wisdom]] of Tobin's Hollow. The Seanchan send a patrol after the escaped Wisdom, as they consider the potential of an unleashed ''[[marath'damane]]'' to be concerning.<ref name="RPG"/>

The village is now under the command of Lord [[Timak]], a low-ranking lord of [[the Blood]]. Forty of his soldiers now occupy the village.
